description: Bring a C++ Vector2 class up to modern value-type style: add operator+ operator- operator* == != and a friend operator<< to include/vector2.hpp, make every method and parameter const-correct, add dot() and length(), and drop the memcmp equality while keeping the legacy API so src/main.cpp compiles unchanged.

criteria: include/vector2.hpp declares operator+ operator- operator* (scalar) operator== operator!= and a friend operator<< plus const dot(const Vector2&) and length() members, takes Vector2 parameters as const references, marks every non-mutating method const, compares equality through the components with no memcmp anywhere, and keeps add/scaled/equals/print delegating to the new operators so the unchanged src/main.cpp still compiles, with the README untouched.
